questions.stem_text:
Jake and Molly each have a few different objects. They want to see which objects can
float. How can they best compare the results of their investigations with each other?

options.A: Drop each object in different liquids.
options.B: Record in a table how each object behaves.
options.C: Measure the length and mass of each object.
options.D: Test the objects in groups from smallest to largest.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Record in a table how each object behaves.

questions.stem_text:
What most likely happens when winter and summer temperatures are below normal and
precipitation rates are above normal?

options.A: Meltwater decreases, and the size of the glacier decreases.
options.B: Meltwater decreases, and the size of the glacier increases.
options.C: Meltwater increases, and the size of the glacier decreases.
options.D: Meltwater increases, and the size of the glacier increases.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Meltwater decreases, and the size of the glacier increases.

questions.stem_text: Which part of a pine tree makes food?
Which statement about the Sun is true?

options.A: The Sun is a very large star that exists far from the Milky Way Galaxy.
options.B: The Sun is at the center of the Milky Way Galaxy.
options.C: The Sun is a medium-sized star near the edge of the Milky Way Galaxy.
options.D: The Sun has the Milky Way and several other galaxies moving in orbits around it.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - The Sun is a medium-sized star near the edge of the Milky Way Galaxy.

questions.stem_text:
Earth's core consists primarily of iron. Which observation about another planet would
provide some evidence that the planet has an iron core?

options.A: the presence of a fluid mantle
options.B: the presence of Van Allen belts
options.D: the presence of water in three states

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - the presence of Van Allen belts
